title: Magical Jamaican Udon Soup
description: A unique Japanese-inspired soup featuring magical and Jamaican flavors.
instructions: Cut the yeasty dough into thin strips.
Heat a pot over medium heat and cook the dough strips until crispy.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Add the Magical Jamaican spice blend and reduce heat to low.
Crack the egg into the pot and stir gently.
Cook for 5 minutes or until the egg is set.
Add the noodles to the pot and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
Garnish with additional Magical Jamaican spice blend if desired.
